_comment: Per-account Amplify config for scripts/amplify-company-sync.mjs. One key per company (the `source` label written to the knocking table). Discover ids by running with --probe. Grow itself is NOT here — it stays in scripts/amplify-knocking-sync.mjs.

tds._includeIds: Dispositions that count as a door. Everything else in the feed (Customer 32147, Lead 32159, Appointment Set 32145, Address Misclassified 32154, and the legacy 'DON'T USE' pair 206887/232290) is integration/CRM noise, not a rep knock.
tds._contactIds: Someone answered the door: Not Interested x4 (32155 Fiber, 32156 Cable, 32157 Price, 32158 Won't Discuss), Sold 32152, Come Back 32148, No Solicitation 82464, Do Not Knock 32150.
tds._excludeReps: Dropped entirely. Jesse Maxwell was deleted from Bria, so his knocking has no comp data to attach to and would sit on unreliable Amplify pins.
tds._includeOrigins: SalesRabbit GPS verification of where the disposition was logged: 4915 'At location', 4910 'Near location' = a real knocked door. Excluded: 4911 'Not at location' (logged away from the door) and 4913 'Unknown' (the 6am integration import, no GPS). Matches the origin filter TDS already uses in the Amplify UI.
